capabilities: Check and uncheck "- ( )" items by clicking in Live Preview, Reading view, embeds, and hover previews
Write and remove done dates (✅ YYYY-MM-DD) when items are toggled
Render progress bars with counts from a "checkboxes" code block for a section, heading, or note
Show completion counts like 3/6 on headings
Convert tasks in a note to checklist items in one undoable step
disambiguation: Not a task manager or a checkbox styling plugin; it only adds a second checkbox syntax for non-task lists and keeps task tools untouched.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual installation or BRAT is required for pre-releases.
problem: Obsidian treats every "- [ ]" as a task, so ordinary lists like grocery lists flood Tasks queries, Dataview task lists, and task searches.
summary: Adds a second checkbox type, "- ( )", for plain checklists that task plugins ignore, with clickable boxes, progress bars, and heading counts.
